+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code

+- 01KYSV5606NB4K39ZXQYPBH0A9
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8580'
+title: 'Transcripts: location policy, recording root, sessions.jsonl index, gitattributes'
+---
+## What
+Plan.md §4.1–§4.4. Create `Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Transcripts/`:
+
+- `TranscriptLocation.swift` — resolve the recording root from `transcripts.location`: `project` (default) → `<cwd>/.<name>/transcripts/`; `home` → shared root with the `-Users-…` slug scheme; absolute path → as given. The resolved root is what `makeSession(recordingRoot:)` receives (Router's `ke41yth` flat `<root>/<sessionId>/` layout does the rest).
+- `SessionIndex.swift` — `sessions.jsonl`: append-only, one self-contained record per line. Record carries `sessionId`, `cwd`, generated `title` (first user prompt, cut to one line), `updatedAt` (RFC 3339, kept in the record), and the complete ordered `additionalDirectories` list (§4.6). Never persist client-supplied `mcpServers` (§7.3 — headers carry bearer tokens and this file is committed). Rebuildable from a scan of session directories (a damaged index is not load-bearing).
+- On first write into a project's transcripts dir, materialize `transcripts/.gitattributes` with `linguist-generated=true` on `transcripts/**` and `merge=union` on `sessions.jsonl` (§4.3). Nothing under `.<name>/` gets ignored. No redaction anywhere (§4.4).
+- `ProjectRegistry.swift` — `~/.config/<name>/projects.jsonl`: append `{path, firstSeen, lastSeen}` when a session starts in a new cwd; paths only, never content; skip stale entries on read (§4.5).
+
+- [ ] Location resolution (project / home / absolute)
+- [ ] Append-only `sessions.jsonl` record shape + rebuild-from-scan
+- [ ] `.gitattributes` materialization
+- [ ] `projects.jsonl` registry append + stale-skip
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Default config resolves the root to `<cwd>/.<name>/transcripts/`
+- [ ] Two appended session records occupy two lines; a torn/corrupt line is skipped on read and the index rebuilds from directories
+- [ ] `.gitattributes` exists with both rules after the first record
+- [ ] An index record round-trips title, updatedAt, and ordered additionalDirectories; no mcpServers field exists
+- [ ] Registry appends once per new cwd and updates lastSeen on revisit
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/TranscriptLocationTests.swift`
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/SessionIndexTests.swift` (incl. corrupt-line and rebuild cases)
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/ProjectRegistryTests.swift`
+- [ ] `swift test` → green
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file

+- `TranscriptLocation.swift` — resolve the recording root from `transcripts.location`. `project` (the default) gives `<cwd>/.<name>/transcripts/`. `home` gives a shared root with the `-Users-…` slug scheme. An absolute path is used as given. The resolved root is what `makeSession(recordingRoot:)` receives.
+
+**The on-disk layout, confirmed against Router:**
+- With `recordingRoot` set, a session directory is `<recordingRoot>/<sessionId>/`.
+- **A fork nests inside its parent's directory, and the nesting IS the lineage record.** No file stores a parent path.
+- Identity is the directory name, and it must parse as a ULID.
+- A directory is a session only if it holds `session.json`.
+- `session.json` is write-once.
+- **`transcript.jsonl` fsyncs only after a `.response` event, so the final line can be torn after a crash.** A reader drops a torn final line with a warning. A corrupt earlier line throws. Match that rule in our own readers.
+- `seq` is global across directories, and a merge sorts by `(ts, seq)`.
+
+- `SessionIndex.swift` — `sessions.jsonl`, append-only, one self-contained record per line. A record carries `sessionId`, `cwd`, the generated `title` (the first user prompt cut to one line), `updatedAt` (RFC 3339), and the complete ordered `additionalDirectories` list. Never persist client-supplied `mcpServers`; headers carry bearer tokens and this file is committed. The index must rebuild from a scan of session directories, because a damaged index is not load-bearing.
+
+- On the first write into a project's transcripts directory, make `transcripts/.gitattributes` with `linguist-generated=true` on `transcripts/**` and `merge=union` on `sessions.jsonl`. Nothing under `.<name>/` is ignored. There is no redaction anywhere.
+
+- `ProjectRegistry.swift` — `~/.config/<name>/projects.jsonl`. Append `{path, firstSeen, lastSeen}` when a session starts in a new cwd. Paths only, never content. Skip stale entries on read.
+
+**Recording level correction: `RecordingLevel` has only two cases, `off` and `full`. There is no `metadata` level.** The old task text and plan §4.3/§4.4 offered `metadata` as a repo-size escape hatch. It does not exist. The only choice is full recording or none. Default to `full`.

-- [ ] Append-only `sessions.jsonl` record shape + rebuild-from-scan

+- [ ] Two appended session records occupy two lines
